# Vendored OpenVSP wheel

Place a locally-built `openvsp-*.whl` here when PyPI has no matching
wheel for the project Python version. See
`docs/md/openvsp-import-setup.md` (Option B) for the build steps.

Vendored wheels are NOT committed to the repository — this directory
is kept tracked only via this README so the build documentation
makes sense. The actual `.whl` is in `.gitignore`.
